{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the mean age
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age}')

# Compute and print the number of valid age entries
valid_age_count = len(df_clean)
print(f'Valid age entries: {valid_age_count}')

# Compute and print the number of missing age entries
missing_age_count = len(df) - valid_age_count
print(f'Missing age entries (age == -1): {missing_age_count}')"}
